Model questions

SC1016 FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the SC1016?

The stated rated capacity is 1,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the SC1016?

The listed lift specification is 1,600 mm configurable. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the SC1016?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
